description: Header file for the STMicroelectronics ISM330DHCX 6-axis IMU sensor driver, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes for sensor initialization and configuration within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_spi_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor driver over SPI interface.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_i2c_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor driver over I2C interface.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_fetch_external_devs
methods.description: Fetches external devices connected via sensor hub.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_get_idx
methods.description: Gets index of a sensor channel in sensor hub.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_shub_config
methods.description: Configures sensor hub external device parameters.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets trigger handlers for sensor events.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt handling for the sensor.
